title: Add RecipesTab with NavigationStack and gear icon
description: Create CookbookApp/Tabs/RecipesTab.swift. Wraps EmptyStateView (systemImage 'book.closed', title 'Recipes', subtitle 'No recipes folder selected.') inside a NavigationStack with navigationTitle 'Recipes'. Adds a trailing toolbar Button with the 'gear' SF Symbol that sets a local @State Boolean to present SettingsView as a sheet.
acceptance_criteria: Tapping the gear button presents SettingsView as a .sheet
EmptyStateView uses systemImage 'book.closed', title 'Recipes', subtitle 'No recipes folder selected.'
